_help: Reusable environment profile for `kuru init --profile <thisfile>`. Copy it OUTSIDE the plugin (e.g. ~/.kuru/profiles/gradle-kube.json) and edit for your org. 'stack' picks a gate preset; 'config' (if present) is used verbatim as .kuru/config.json (overrides 'stack'); 'environment' pre-answers the charter's Technical environment so you don't re-type it each project. Nothing here is secret-by-design — internal URLs are fine, but gitignore the profile if you prefer.

config._help: OPTIONAL. Omit to just use the 'stack' preset. If present, this becomes .kuru/config.json verbatim (project name is filled in for you). Air-gapped example: gradle --offline against a populated cache.

airgap.notes: no internet during build; init.gradle points at the mirror; gradle runs --offline
